text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I appreciate your help. I'll go and rest<n>a while.
Hayahide... Hey, Hayahide...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm? I hear a girl's voice...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide's Glasses
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that'd be me! Yer favorite<n>pair'a glasses!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: M-my glasses can talk?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Uh... What is it? Can I help you with<n>something?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide's Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Aw, I jus' wanted ta thank ya for<n>always showing
me such amazing<n>sights! ♪

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm... sorry? I don't recall showing<n>you anything in
particular.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide's Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Aw, sure ya have! I love seeing yer<n>thrilling races
and all yer fans'<n>smiles.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide's Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Not ta mention yer fierce rivalries and<n>the way the
finish line looks as we<n>rush toward it!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide's Glasses
text_block_list.text:
And ta think I get to see it all from the<n>best seat in
the house! Why, I'm<n>jus' over the moon thankful
for ya!<n>Heehee!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: No, it is I who should be thanking you,<n>my dear ally.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I'm feeling too hopeless to<n>focus on
what's ahead... or I become<n>overconfident in
victory and lose sight<n>of my goals...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're always there to help me clear<n>my vision and
show me the path to<n>victory!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I hope we can continue supporting<n>each other for a
long time. Hehe!

Biwa Hayahide feels refreshed by<n>the sweet
dream.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide's Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Don't you even think about cheatin'<n>on me with
contact lenses!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wh-what kind of dream was that?

Biwa Hayahide feels disturbed by the<n>strange
dream...
